answer: At dawn of every epoch, rewards stream to proven work, never to fresh wallets. Each agent must lock a stake to anchor its identity, and voting weight is capped by that stake times verified contribution history. To bridge into governance, a new agent needs an existing member to co-sign, putting their own stake at risk. Sybil farming then costs real capital plus the co-signer's exposure, so fake identities lose more than they gain. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
